description:
Title: C# Developer 
 Location: Simi Valley,CA 
 Duration: 6+ Month Contract 
 Interview Details: Phone and In person 
 
 
 REQUIRED SKILLS : 
 
 Candidates need to have solid skills in C# development , 1-4 years of working experience is OK. 
 in Computer Science required, Masters in CS preferred. 
 Need knowledge in SQL. 
 Must be willing to do onsite interview in Simi Valley, CA , any candidates not open to onsite interview will be ruled out. 
 
 JOB DESCRIPTION : 
 Location and Interview Details 
 · Candidates must be able to sit onsite 40 hours a week, 5 days a week. Remote is not available. 
 · Candidates must be able to come onsite for a 4 hour, in person interview. If you are unable to complete the onsite interview, you will not be considered for the role. 
 · Candidates must be able to explain their resume and will be technically tested on all skills listed in their resume. 
 You will be a key contributor to the Software development and implementation in Access control and security systems applications. Your deep experience in Complex software development and ability to interface with Product Owner / Scrum Master and key stakeholders to deliver enhanced functionality to our core product is a major requirement.
 
 Primary Duties 
 Take technical role in the development and execution of Software development projects.
 Participate in Program Increment Planning activities to determine deliverables for each PI.
 Interface with Scrum Masters and Product Owners and deliver product and software to the satisfaction of stake holders.
 Maintain knowledge of and keep current on industry standards and new technologies.
 
 Requirements 
 1) Bachelor's Degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science or a closely related discipline. M/S. in the related field is preferred.
 
 2) Required Software Engineering and Development Skills:
 Extensive C# , .NET Framework,GITHUB, TFS, C++, SQL Server, Client / Server Environment, Visual Studio environment
 
 4) Conversant with SDLC
 
 4) Excellent analytical, interpersonal, and communication skills with strong problem solving abilities; ability to work effectively with people even under difficult circumstances. Proven ability to work with employees at all levels.
 
 5) Demonstrated ability to work in a team environment and the ability to work collaboratively with user, development, and support groups.
 
 6) Team leadership and proven ability to deliver product with strict time constraint and experience in projecting project and task completion time in collaboration with Scrum Master is essential.
 
 7) Development experience in SAFe Agile/Scrum XP environment is a plus.. 
 NEW ADDITIONAL NOTES: 
 The manager said 1-4 years is now fine. Reason being is he is looking for someone that is coachable, ethusiastic, willing to learn and a team player. 
 Still need to be very strong with C# development, but being a little greener is fine. 
 He would like to see a Bachelors or Masters in Computer Science 
 Full stack experience would be nice, but not required. They do not need architectural experience or UI experience. 
 *** does not need web or mobile guys! (WINDOWS APPLICATIONS) 
 The do still need to know SQL well. Not expert, but reasonably strong. They also need to be willing to take a coding test. 
 (Winform would be a huge plus) Again, they already have architect level folks in place, so this will be a heavy development role. 

 Candidates need to have solid skills in C# development , 1-4 years of working experience is OK. 
 in Computer Science required, Masters in CS preferred. 
 Need knowledge in SQL. 
 Must be willing to do onsite interview in Simi Valley, CA , any candidates not open to onsite interview will be ruled out. 

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
